input:
Write 5 emails of category `purchase_request`, one per slot below, each with its label as described in the brief. Every email must be different in sender, organisation, products and wording.

Slots:
1. English, from a Singapore polyclinic lab: plans to order next month and asks to reserve stock; no PO.
2. Malay mixed with English, casual phone style, from a clinic in Kuala Lumpur: wants roughly 40 boxes next quarter, can you hold stock; no PO.
3. Vietnamese WITH diacritics, from a provincial hospital planning next year's tender quantities for two reagents.
4. Bahasa Indonesia, from hospital purchasing: an internal purchase requisition number (not a PO) and quantities; says the PO will follow after the director signs. Close call between order and plan, but no confirmed order yet.
5. English, terse, from a Thai hospital: budget approved for one centrifuge in Q1, PO will come in January, please keep the price.

emails.body:
Hi team,

We are planning to place an order next month for HbA1c Reagent Kit x 6 kits and CRP Quantitative Reagent x 4 kits for the lab at Tampines Heights Polyclinic. Could you please reserve the stock for us first? We will raise the PO once finance signs off, so there is no PO number yet.

Please let me know if the current stock can cover this.

Thanks and regards,
Rachel Tan
Senior Medical Technologist, Laboratory
Tampines Heights Polyclinic
Tel: +65 6123 4567
emails.gist: Singapore polyclinic lab plans to order HbA1c and CRP kits next month and asks Lives to reserve stock; PO to follow.
emails.subject: Reserve stock for next month - HbA1c and CRP kits

Kính gửi Quý công ty,

Bệnh viện Đa khoa tỉnh Bình Hòa đang lập kế hoạch đấu thầu vật tư xét nghiệm cho năm 2027. Khoa Xét nghiệm dự kiến số lượng như sau:

- Thuốc thử HbA1c: 120 kit

Đề nghị Quý công ty ghi nhận số lượng dự kiến này để chuẩn bị hồ sơ và hàng hóa. Chúng tôi sẽ thông báo chính thức khi kế hoạch được phê duyệt.

Trân trọng,
Nguyễn Thị Lan

Selamat siang Bapak/Ibu,

Berikut kami sampaikan kebutuhan RS Mitra Sejahtera berdasarkan Purchase Requisition internal nomor PR-2026/0457 (bukan nomor PO):
- Dengue IgG/IgM Rapid Test Kit: 30 box

Terima kasih.
Dewi Anggraini
Staf Purchasing, RS Mitra Sejahtera Bekasi
HP 0812-3456-7788
